notes.notes: - Corrected issue with the Resolution settings menu not interacting with Controllers and Steam Deck.

notes.title: OLIJA 1.1
notes.notes:
[i]General performance improvement, bug fixes and new setting parameters to adjust various options.[/i]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[list]
[*]
[/list]Fixed a bug that sometimes caused the players to get stuck in the ground after Harpoon-dashing.
[list]
[*]
[/list]The players should no longer be able to walk over water on the edges of the boat.
[list]
[*]
[/list]The final boss's health bar should properly disappear now.
[list]
[*]
[/list]The players are now not able to run during certain cutscenes.
[list]
[*]
[/list]The UI should no longer display a hat power gauge when not wearing a hat.
[list]
[*]
[/list]Fixed various invisible colliders getting players stuck when in walking motion.
[list]
[*]
[/list]Players will now fall on spikes instead of possibly getting stuck when falling from the top of the Tower boss fight.
[list]
[*]
[/list]Reduced the chance that the game will freeze during a loading screen.
[list]
[*]
[/list]Fixed a spot where players could get stuck after harpoon dashing in the Prison.
New settings and improvements
[list]
[*]
[/list]Settings menu : Controller vibration can be turned on and off.
[list]
[*]
[/list]Settings menu : Render scale option that allows to adjust the game's render quality for slow machines.
[list]
[*]
[/list]Settings menu : Resolution setting that allows for changing the resolution of the game.
[list]
[*]
[/list]Settings menu : Fullscreen button to enable or disable fullscreen.

notes.title: Увлекательное приключение в стиле ретро: Обзор Olija
notes.notes: Инди-студии часто прибегают к пиксельному стилю в реализации своих проектов, вдохновляясь 8-битной игровой классикой или привлекательным минимализмом подобного направления. Команда Skeleton Crew Studio делает своеобразный оммаж классическим экшен-приключениям, вроде Another World, погружая игрока в визуально примитивный мир Olija.
